One-Piece 3D Printing for Large Parts

The Raise3D T Series combines large build volumes with production-focused motion, extrusion, and thermal management—giving manufacturers a practical option for printing suitable large parts in one piece.

One-piece prints avoid bonded joints that may weaken under load. They are useful for functional prototypes and testing, and can be used as end-use parts when the material, design, and process are validated.

A larger build volume enables full-scale parts beyond desktop prototypes. Examples include casting patterns, sculptures, spinal orthoses, large molds, tooling, and drones—parts that might otherwise need another manufacturing process or extensive assembly.
Large-Format FFF 3D Printing with TwinFlow™

A faster-moving printhead does not automatically produce a finished part sooner. Short toolpaths, cooling time, and the hotend’s ability to melt and deliver material can all affect overall print time. TwinFlow™ is designed to improve material delivery efficiency, helping support faster printing.

TwinFlow™ features two independent filament paths feeding into a single output nozzle, supporting two operating modes. In high-flow mode, both paths simultaneously feed the same material to increase extrusion capacity. In dual-material mode, the system switches between different materials through the two feed paths, enabling compatible dual-material printing workflows.

The combined cross-sectional area of two 1.75 mm filaments is theoretically equivalent to that of a single circular filament approximately 2.47 mm in diameter. This is a theoretical area comparison only. TwinFlow™ uses two 1.75 mm filaments, not a 2.47 mm filament.
